text:
maria-b: Hi team, I'm Maria starting today from São Paulo (maria@freelance.cloud). I accepted the Okta invite but my Google alias (maria@redwood.dev) didn't attach so Drive + Gmail access missing. 1Password shows "no seat" and SMS MFA is failing (Brazil roaming). Any temporary access options so I can start onboarding tasks?

it-len: Welcome Maria! Can you DM a personal email for a temp Drive share? We can also issue a 1Password guest vault for 48h and enable TOTP for MFA while SMS is flaky. Which TOTP app do you prefer?

maria-b: DM'd maria.personal@gmail.com. I use Authy. TOTP is fine.

provision-bot: INC-3124 created by it-len: "Contractor alias mismatch + 1Password seat + MFA" priority P2.

devex-kai: Sending a 48h 1Password guest vault link in DM now (do not store long-term secrets). Also sharing onboarding Drive folder to your personal gmail. Quick checklist DMed: `ssh key`, `starter tasks`, `workstation VPN steps`.

it-len: Shared Drive and added you to contractors-temp group for basic access. I see SCIM/Okta created the profile with the freelance.cloud primary email; our alias mapping for freelance.cloud -> redwood.dev isn't present. I'll ping infra to add a scoped mapping and re-run the sync.

peopleops-rina: Welcome Maria! People Ops sent contractor packet and payment form to your personal email. Ping me for any benefits/expense questions. :wave:

provision-bot: INC-3124 status update  infra notified; alias mapping planned, ETA 4-8h. 1Password seat request forwarded to licensing.

maria-b: Guest 1Password link and Drive share received, thanks. Quick Q: I need access to a private repo for my first ticket  who grants GitHub access?

it-len: DM your GitHub handle and public SSH key and we'll add you to the contractors team. We can also invite via personal gmail if that is easier until alias is canonical.

maria-b: DMed handle + key. Also: will fixing the alias resolve the SMS delivery problem or should I keep TOTP?

it-len: Fixing the alias should make Okta profile canonical and may improve SMS routing, but keep TOTP as primary until we confirm. We'll re-run the SSO sync after infra change. :thumbsup:

provision-bot: INC-3124 updated  infra assigned; estimated fix 4-8 hours. Licensing notified for 1Password seat.

maria-b: Appreciate the quick help everyone, I'll proceed with tasks using the temp access and TOTP and report if anything else pops up. :)
